description: Distributor handles {:coverage_demand, tag}: pick node via coordinator service directory capabilities -> that node's Foreman starts materializer worker -> epoch lock/unlock (existing recovery machinery, single authority) -> TSL delta to Director (A4) -> {:covered, tag, pid} to placeholder. Backoff on failure; telemetry for demand/spin-up duration/park/shed counts. Read-version handoff: recruited materializer replays to current; version_too_old after long spin-up is acceptable client-retry.
title: On-demand materializer recruitment flow
